uncovered_features.feature_name: TLS 1.2+ with secure cipher suites support
uncovered_features.feature_summary: App Engine flexible environment made TLS 1.2 and later support generally available, including the corresponding secure cipher suites.

uncovered_features.feature_name: TLS 1.1 and earlier support
uncovered_features.feature_summary: Support for TLS versions 1.1 and earlier was deprecated for App Engine flexible environment; deprecated on March 2025.
keywords: TLS 1.1 and earlier in App Engine

uncovered_features.feature_name: Node.js 22 runtime support
uncovered_features.feature_summary: App Engine flexible environment made Node.js 22 generally available.

uncovered_features.feature_name: App Engine Console runtime lifecycle stage filtering
uncovered_features.feature_summary: The App Engine Console now supports filtering versions by runtime lifecycle stage and displays warning icons for support and deprecation status.

uncovered_features.feature_name: Node.js 22 runtime preview support
uncovered_features.feature_summary: Node.js 22 became available in Preview for App Engine flexible environment.

uncovered_features.feature_name: Pnpm package manager support for Node.js runtimes
uncovered_features.feature_summary: App Engine flexible environment added support for using Pnpm to manage dependencies for Node.js 18 and Node.js 20 preview runtimes.

uncovered_features.feature_name: Node.js 20 runtime preview support
uncovered_features.feature_summary: Node.js 20 support entered Preview for App Engine flexible environment.

uncovered_features.feature_name: SSH access to internal-IP-only flexible instances
uncovered_features.feature_summary: App Engine flexible environment now allows SSH login to instances that use only internal IP addresses.

uncovered_features.feature_name: App Engine flexible environment Node.js 18 runtime
uncovered_features.feature_summary: The Node.js 18 runtime became available in preview for App Engine flexible environment on Ubuntu 22, using Google Cloud buildpacks and requiring app.yaml updates.

uncovered_features.feature_name: App Engine flexible environment internal IP mode
uncovered_features.feature_summary: App Engine flexible environment instances gained a configurable option to set IP mode to internal.

uncovered_features.feature_name: App Engine flexible environment external ephemeral IP disabling
uncovered_features.feature_summary: App Engine Flex services gained the ability to disable external ephemeral IP addresses for instances.

uncovered_features.feature_name: App Engine regional availability expansion
uncovered_features.feature_summary: App Engine became available in us-west1 (Oregon), asia-southeast1 (Singapore), and asia-east1 (Taiwan); App Engine became available in region europe-central2 (Warsaw).

uncovered_features.feature_name: App Engine support for external HTTP(S) load balancing via Serverless NEGs
uncovered_features.feature_summary: External HTTP(S) Load Balancing is now supported for App Engine through Serverless Network Endpoint Groups.
keywords: App Engine with serverless network endpoint groups
App Engine backend service for NEG

uncovered_features.feature_summary: App Engine is available in the us-west4 (Las Vegas, NV) region.

uncovered_features.feature_name: App Engine regional availability in asia-northeast3
uncovered_features.feature_summary: App Engine is available in the asia-northeast3 (Seoul) region.

uncovered_features.feature_name: App Engine regional availability in us-west3
uncovered_features.feature_summary: App Engine is available in the us-west3 (Salt Lake City, Utah) region.

uncovered_features.feature_summary: App Engine now supports request URLs that include a region ID (for example, PROJECT_ID.REGION_ID.r.appspot.com).

uncovered_features.feature_summary: App Engine is available in the asia-northeast2 (Osaka, Japan) region.

uncovered_features.feature_name: App Engine regional availability in europe-west6

uncovered_features.feature_summary: App Engine is available in the asia-east2 (Hong Kong) region.

uncovered_features.feature_name: App Engine regional availability in us-west2
uncovered_features.feature_summary: App Engine is available in the us-west2 (Los Angeles) region.

uncovered_features.feature_name: App Engine regional availability in northamerica-northeast1
uncovered_features.feature_summary: App Engine became available in the northamerica-northeast1 (Montreal, Canada) region.

uncovered_features.feature_name: App Engine regional availability in asia-south1
uncovered_features.feature_summary: App Engine became available in the asia-south1 (Mumbai, India) region.

uncovered_features.feature_name: Default Node.js runtime version in App Engine flexible environment
uncovered_features.feature_summary: For unpinned applications, the App Engine Node.js runtime now defaults to the latest Node.js v8 LTS release.

uncovered_features.feature_name: Automatic gzip response compression for App Engine flexible environment
uncovered_features.feature_summary: App Engine flexible environment began compressing all responses with gzip by default after redeploying an app, with no app.yaml changes required.

uncovered_features.feature_name: Per-second instance billing for App Engine flexible environment
uncovered_features.feature_summary: Flexible environment instance billing changed from per-minute to per-second increments, and minimum usage was reduced from 10 minutes to 1 minute.

uncovered_features.feature_name: Legacy health checks
uncovered_features.feature_summary: Legacy health checks were deprecated and discontinued for App Engine after September 30, 2018; deprecated on 2018-09-30.

uncovered_features.feature_name: General availability of App Engine custom domain mapping APIs and CLI
uncovered_features.feature_summary: Gcloud and Admin API methods for custom domain mapping, including domains verify and apps.authorizedDomains.list, became generally available.
keywords: App Engine Admin API domain mapping

uncovered_features.feature_name: Managed SSL certificate upgrade for existing custom domains
uncovered_features.feature_summary: Existing domain mappings and SSL certificates in App Engine can continue functioning, and users can upgrade to managed SSL certificates.

uncovered_features.feature_name: App Engine region expansion: southamerica-east1
uncovered_features.feature_summary: App Engine was made available in the southamerica-east1 region (Sao Paulo, Brazil).

uncovered_features.feature_name: App Engine firewall (beta)

uncovered_features.feature_name: App Engine region expansion: europe-west2
uncovered_features.feature_summary: App Engine was made available in the europe-west2 region (London).

uncovered_features.feature_name: App Engine region expansion: us-east4

uncovered_features.feature_name: Task Queue API migration guidance to Cloud Tasks in flexible environment
uncovered_features.feature_summary: App Engine updated task queue guidance to direct flexible environment users from Task Queue API to Cloud Tasks and added instructions for verifying Task Queue API requests.

uncovered_features.feature_name: App Engine flexible environment .NET Core runtime
